definition: Ask the solver to prove a placement, holding the record's declared facts as hard constraints. It returns a placement, or names the smallest set of facts that cannot all hold. It takes seconds, so a wall drag stays on the fast search.
basis: Our wording of the proof on demand. docs/geometry.md: "Solving is two-phase: a hard-only pass finds or refutes a placement fast", and on infeasibility "The footprint grows a bay before any requirement is blamed."
